description: This file defines a data model class 'ListItemObject' for representing individual items in a ListView, including properties like title, image resource, and height, with corresponding getters and a constructor.

classes.name: ListItemObject
classes.description: A model class representing an item in the ListView with properties for title, image resource, and height, used for data binding within the ListView adapter.

methods.name: ListItemObject
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a ListItemObject with a title, image resource, and height.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the list item.

methods.name: getImgResource
methods.description: Returns the image resource ID associated with the list item.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the default height of the list item.
